summary.text: Tracy Katz Muhl is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 57, in office since January 2024, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former Northbrook School District 28 board president, she was appointed to the seat to replace Jonathan Carroll.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Katz Muhl grew up in Northbrook, Illinois.
She received an undergraduate degree from Georgetown University and a law degree from the University of Chicago, and her professional experience includes working as an attorney.
Katz Muhl served as school board president for Northbrook School District 28.
Katz Muhl was appointed to the House to replace Jonathan Carroll (D) and assumed office on January 12, 2024.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Appropriations-Health and Human Services, Gun Violence Prevention, House Higher Education, Judiciary - Civil and House Insurance committees, and as vice-chair of the Mental Health & Addiction Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Daniel Behr (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
